Study tools

01 Reference⌄

Choose a photo to begin. Photos stay in your browser and clear on refresh.

02 Sphere & alignment⌄

03 Face, eyes & lips⌄

Drag blue points onto the visible face edge and feature corners. Left and right refer to your screen.

Fine-tune a point
Image pixels. Select a point, then use arrow keys on the canvas. Shift moves 10 pixels.

Reference measurements

Measured from your placed points in image pixels.
04 Display settings⌄

Fade the reference with “Photo opacity” in Sphere & alignment, or hide it beside the canvas.

How to use the studio
  1. Choose a portrait or try the example.
  2. Fit the circle to the cranium with size, tilt and face turn.
  3. Place blue points on the cheek, jaw, eyes and lips.
  4. Hide the photo to inspect your structure, or download the study.

Privacy & security

Your portrait is yours. We don?t upload or store your photos or study adjustments on our servers.

BROWSER ONLY
What happens to my photo?

Your uploaded photo and study adjustments are held temporarily in this page?s browser memory. The app does not save them in browser storage or send them to a server for processing.

As soon as you refresh the page, your uploaded photo and adjustments disappear from the studio. Download your study first if you want to keep it.

Refreshing does not delete your original photo or any PNG you downloaded. The built-in lesson portrait is included with the site and remains available. The hosting provider may process normal connection and access information to serve the website; this notice describes how the studio handles your photos and studies.
